About us

An archive of pixel art NFT collections

PixelVault gathers pixel art and digital images, organized in collections and signed by their artist.

Every piece is an NFT. The QR code on the image leads to a public page saying who owns it: the owner stays anonymous, only an alias or a wallet address is shown.

How we work

Three simple rules

Clarity
  • Price and license written on the page
  • Ownership can be checked with a QR
Artists first
  • Every piece shows who created it
  • Themed collections, one at a time
No promises
  • An NFT is not an investment
  • No returns or price rises promised
